title: Rational stalk Frobenius powers along a closed-point orbit
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite. Let $X_0$ be separated of finite type over $k_0$, put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $(K_E,\varphi_E)$ be an $E$-Weil complex [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], with an integral representative whose reductions are in $D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)$. Use the $E$-stage stalk operators and their specified normalized stalk transports from [prop-trf-rational-frobenius-integral-model]. Let $x\in|X_0|$ be a closed point, $e=[\kappa(x):k_0]$, and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. A lift is a $k$-morphism $z:s\to X$ above $x$. Put $\sigma(c)=c^q$, $\gamma=\sigma^{-1}$ and $g=\operatorname{id}_{X_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$. For any starting lift $z_0$, enumerate the lifts by $z_i=g^iz_0\operatorname{Spec}(\sigma^i)$, $0\le i<e$. Denote by $y_{i,m}\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})$ the rational point represented by $z_i$ when $e\mid m$. Put $F_x=F_{y_{0,e},e}$ on the rational stalk complex $K_{E,z_0}$. Then there are $E$-linear isomorphisms of stalk complexes $T_i:K_{E,z_i}\xrightarrow{\sim}K_{E,z_0}$, with $T_0=1$, such that for every $r\ge1$,
$$F_{y_{i,er},er}=T_i^{-1}F_x^rT_i\qquad(0\le i<e).$$
In particular the conjugacy class of $F_x$ is independent of the starting lift. The equality uses the normalized fixed-point operators, including the source reparametrization displayed above. Only invertibility of $\varphi_E$ in $D^b_c(X,E)$ is assumed; no invertible Weil structure on an integral lattice is required.
